text.description_html:
Acorn PMH-T-08, Grooved Stainless Steel Descartes Pull

The Grooved Stainless Steel Descartes Cabinet Pull is a simple cabinet handle with a subtle unique detail that elevates it from the ordinary to something more interesting. The grooves in the mounts provide depth. Made out of stainless steel, the Descartes Cabinet Pull has a brushed stainless steel finish, for a beautiful, modern look.

Also Available Matching Descartes Cabinet Knob

Specifications of the Grooved Stainless Steel Descartes Cabinet Pull:

  • Finish: Brushed Stainless Steel
  • Material: Solid Stainless Steel
  • Center to Center: 3-3/4"
  • Overall Length: 4-21/32"
  • Height: 1/2"
  • Projection: 1-1/8"
  • Package includes 1 pull and hardware for installation.

Sold individually.
